newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-NOTTINGHAMSHIRE SEEK REPLACEMENT FOR CAIRNS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NOTTINGHAMSHIRE SEEK REPLACEMENT FOR CAIRNS.

text.p: England county side Nottinghamshire are seeking a replacement for New Zealand all-rounder Chris Cairns who will undergo an operation on a chipped ankle bone this month.
Cairns, 27, is playing solely as a batsman in the current series against Sri Lanka and might not be able to bowl for Nottinghamshire until June or July.
The county are currently seeking a fast bowling replacement from either Australia or South Africa and a spokesman said they hoped to resolve the problem within the next two weeks.
